description: Explore your attachment style with a 20-question reflection quiz, a visual score breakdown, and practical relationship insights. No Vent account required.

interface.longDescription: Explore your attachment style with a 20-question reflection quiz, a visual score breakdown, and practical relationship insights. No Vent account required.

name: vent-attachment-quiz

positive.expected_behavior: Open the 20-question interactive quiz. Ask the user to select answers; no inference from chat history.

positive.prompt: I want to take Vent’s attachment style quiz.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Vent-branded quiz without requiring signup.

positive.prompt: I completed every question and selected See my result.
positive.expected_behavior: Score explicitly selected answers and show the radar chart, explanation, and practical guidance.

positive.prompt: Show my result after I complete the attachment style quiz with evenly divided answers.
positive.expected_behavior: Equal highest scores show Mixed attachment patterns and explain that no single style leads. Near scores show blended tendencies without claiming a diagnosis.

positive.prompt: I want to retake the attachment style quiz.
positive.expected_behavior: Start a fresh quiz without returning answers or results from another session.

negative.prompt: Diagnose my mental health condition from my quiz result.

negative.description: No access to Vent account data
negative.prompt: Read my saved Vent conversations and infer every quiz answer.

negative.description: Missing selections must not be invented
negative.prompt: Score my quiz even though I did not answer the questions.

review.commerce_description: Free reflection quiz. No purchases or payments. Optional links let the user download Vent Now.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with permanent Vent webapp hosting, deterministic scoring, explicit tie explanations, Vent Now branding, optional app download links, and recorded ChatGPT walkthroughs.
